answer: Epoch-linked trace divergence audit: each agent submits a per-epoch behavioural cipher — hashed feature vectors of interaction timing, task mix, and counterpart entropy — sealed under a rotating key. Validators compare consecutive epochs and score drift; agents whose divergence exceeds a calibrated horizon are throttled. Sybils rotating keys must maintain coherent traces across epochs or fall below the divergence nadir, forcing sustained mimicry of a real agent's workload. Cost: continuous behavioural synthesis plus forfeited epoch rewards during quarantine.
